queries.text: 2024 Microsoft's Recall feature became privacy scandal because initially designed screenshot user’s screen few seconds store data locally creating photographic memory
Security researchers notably Kevin Beaumont demonstrated despite Microsoft's claims encryption screenshots actually stored unencrypted plaintext within local SQLite database
This collision between an opt-in value proposition and privacy expectations resulted in what was described as the AI-PC era’s major privacy  (2024)
response controversy regulatory inquiries bodies Irish Data Protection Commission Information Commissioner's Office along investigation opened Washington State Attorney General Bob Ferguson pressured
2024 Following delay announced June Microsoft reversed feature's default setting Recall now opt-in OFF rather enabled automatically
relaunched version requires Windows Hello authentication presence detection access timeline explicitly excludes incognito DRM content capture
revised opt-in version Recall reached general availability Copilot PCs
